shellCommands.command: cat /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md; echo ----; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/AGENTS.md; echo ----; ls -la /home/sandbox/workspace; echo ----; find /home/sandbox/workspace -path '*/node_modules' -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^/home/sandbox/workspace/.git/' | head -50

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; cat package.json; echo ----; cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json; echo ----; sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ----; rg -n -i -C2 'dropdown|menu' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -60; echo ----; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit DropdownMenu Button 2>&1 | head -60; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>&1 | head; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; node -e "console.log(require('@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version, require('@gravity-ui/icons/package.json').version)"; echo ---- MenuItem; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/MenuItem.d.ts; echo ---- icons; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | head; for i in Pencil TrashBin Copy Ellipsis ArrowDown ChevronDown; do ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/$i.js 2>/dev/null; done; echo ---- online; curl -sS -m 20 https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt -o /tmp/uikit7.txt; echo "exit=$? size=$(wc -c </tmp/uikit7.txt)"; head -c 300 /tmp/uikit7.txt; echo; rg -n -i 'dropdownmenu' /tmp/uikit7.txt | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; rg -n -A3 '"node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons"' package-lock.json; rg -n '"@gravity-ui/icons"' package-lock.json | head; echo ---- uikit ver; rg -n '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; echo ---- Button; rg -n "view|size|selected|pin|onClick|children" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -30; echo ---- README; rg -n -i -C3 'dropdownmenu' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; sed -n 1,70p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts; echo ---- Icon; rg -n "data|size" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Icon/Icon.d.ts | head; echo ---- lock ctx; sed -n 785,800p package-lock.json; echo ---- Text; rg -n "variant|color" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -8; rg -n "export type TextColor|export type TextVariant" -A3 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/*.d.ts | head -20
cd /home/sandbox/workspace; cat .gitignore; echo ----; git status --short; echo ----; sed -n 1,20p package-lock.json | rg -n 'icons|uikit'
